# AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)

> A curated AI tool directory & review platform for Hong Kong and global Chinese-speaking users. Currently lists 155 AI tools across 30 categories (AI API, AI Agents, AI Audio, AI Automation, AI Chat, AI Coding, AI Design, AI Dev, AI Development, AI E-commerce, AI Image, AI Images), with editor-tested reviews covering features, pricing, pros/cons and use cases. The site is updated daily.
